ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approx 90% of visible surface area, with high-intensity (white/yellow) pixels localized at distal tips; dark-to-light pixel ratio estimated at 10:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation (RGB < 50,50,50) across both central lobes. A distinct, high-contrast contiguous yellowish-white blob is mapped to the distal tip of the right lobe (image right). Sparse white punctate clusters are mapped to the distal portion of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 135 degrees relative to the lobe horizons; base of notch is partially occluded by water surface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth serrations observed along the entire trailing edge of both lobes; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 3 and 10 pixels against the background water contrast.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a moderate convex upward sweep (positive curvature) starting from the median notch and terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of punctate white pixel clusters (approx 2-5 pixel diameter) localized on the trailing margin of the left lobe and within the larger white patch on the right lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced yellowish-white scarred region on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe, indicating potential tissue wear or calcified colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive yellowish chromatic shift in the high-intensity pixels of the right lobe tip, contrasting with the standard neutral white reflectivity seen in similar whale fluke pigmentation.
